name: Take Your Time Richmond 2023

venue.name: [J.N. Burnett Secondary School](https://jnburnett.sd38.bc.ca/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the Multipurpose room

information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Note that 3x3 speedsolving will NOT be held at this competition. If you are looking to compete in events that are not being held, please look for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?event_ids%255B%255D=333&region=_North+America&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). ***Event start times may change depending on registration totals. Competitors will be notified about changes after registration has closed.*** You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 1 guest each. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
